2608.24658.title: Parason: Revealing Subtask and Trial Parallelism in LLM Reasoning
2608.24658.paper_summary: Scaling test-time reasoning has substantially improved the problem-solving ability of large language models (LLMs), but standard autoregressive decoding still executes long reasoning traces sequentially, creating severe latency for difficult tasks (up to days and weeks). Parallel reasoning offers a natural remedy. However, prior systems primarily focus on Subtask Parallelism, where the model learns to decompose a high-level task into smaller chunks that can be solved independently. This approach overlooks another pervasive form of parallelism: Trial Parallelism, where multiple speculative attempts explore, verify, and aggregate competing hypotheses in parallel. In this paper, we introduce Parason, which reveals and learns both forms of parallelism in LLM reasoning. Our analysis identifies Trial Parallelism as the majority of parallelizable reasoning computation (65.5% in DeepSeek-V4's reasoning steps in HLE), and it becomes increasingly dominant on hard problems. Guided by this taxonomy, Parason converts sequential reasoning traces into structured parallel trajectories with a context-free grammar, then trains models with Parallelism-Aware Group Relative Policy Optimization (PA-GRPO), whose reward jointly balances accuracy, latency, and the two parallelism ratios. At inference time, Parason executes the learned parallel structure through tool calls, translating theoretical savings to real-world wall-clock acceleration. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks including AIME24 and AIME25 show that Parason achieves an average acceleration about 1.7$\times$ while maintaining competitive accuracy.
2608.24658.paper_summary_zh: 擴展測試時的推理顯著提升了大型語言模型（LLMs）的問題解決能力，但標準自回歸解碼仍然按順序執行長推理過程，對於困難任務造成了嚴重的延遲（長達數天和數週）。並行推理提供了一種自然的解決方案。然而，之前的系統主要集中在子任務並行性上，模型學習將高層次任務分解為可以獨立解決的小塊。這種方法忽略了另一種普遍的並行性形式：試驗並行性，其中多個推測性嘗試並行探索、驗證和聚合競爭假設。在本文中，我們介紹了Parason，它揭示並學習LLM推理中的這兩種並行性。我們的分析確定試驗並行性佔可並行推理計算的絕大多數（在HLE中DeepSeek-V4的推理步驟中為65.5%），並且在困難問題上變得越來越主導。在這一分類法的指導下，Parason將順序推理過程轉換為結構化的並行軌跡，使用無上下文文法，然後通過並行意識的群體相對策略優化（PA-GRPO）訓練模型，其獎勵共同平衡準確性、延遲和兩種並行性比率。在推理時，Parason通過工具調用執行學習到的並行結構，將理論上的節省轉化為現實世界的時鐘加速。在包括AIME24和AIME25的數學推理基準上的實驗顯示，Parason在保持競爭準確性的同時，實現了約1.7$\times$的平均加速。
